source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pairs = []
    pair_colors = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    pairs.append((r, c, dr, dc, color))
                    pair_colors.add(color)
    if len(pair_colors) < 3:
        return out
    for r, c, dr, dc, color in pairs:
        for sr, sc in ((-dr, -dc), (dr, dc)):
            rr, cc = (r, c) if (sr, sc) == (-dr, -dc) else (r + dr, c + dc)
            rr += sr
            cc += sc
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == bg:
                out[rr][cc] = color
                rr += sr
                cc += sc
    return out
'''
